{{Otheruses|Totem}}
'''Totems of the Elementals''' were [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] artifacts that could summon Night, Sunlight, Smoke, Ice, Flame, Clay, and Woodrot. They were powerful, primal entities and would not always obey the wielder's bidding.
